title: EUR-Lex-Sum: A Multi- and Cross-lingual Dataset for Long-form Summarization in the Legal Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution and availability of document-summary pairs across 24 official EU languages, identifying representation disparities for more recently added official languages (e.g., Irish, Croatian) and acknowledging an overall availability bias towards European languages.

Evaluating dataset abstractiveness using n-gram novelty metrics and carefully structuring single-reference document selection to preserve natural text orderings, which ensures the correct processing and evaluation of positional lead bias in summarization models.
